status_authority: This JSON is the single work/status source; the Markdown is its generated human view.

finish_lines.explicit_stitch: One explicitly chosen canonical connection can be placed, locally qualified, compared against a matched refinement control and inspected as an immutable unselected child (S01, S03-S07).
finish_lines.campaign_stitch: Add qualified end inference and bounded campaign-local transfer/review (S02, S08), without repeated member prompts or silent promotion.
finish_lines.pine_slicing: A scientist can choose, preview and materialize a faithful ASU cut, prove physical/scattering invariance, preserve seam chemistry and complete the persistent graphical review/refine loop (P01-P06).

audit_rules: Read this queue and the current handoff at session start; identify the job and its exact missing acceptance gate before coding.
At each substantial tested/pushed slice, native result, changed assumption, blocker or handoff, update delivered scope, evidence, status and next action together; rerun the roadmap audit.

A job closes only when every criterion is supported in the declared scope and dependencies are qualified for that same scope. Unit tests, optimizer convergence, native interpretation and scientific/human acceptance are distinct.
Keep partial/negative results and original caveats. Reopen a closed scope when new evidence contradicts it; record why rather than silently rewriting a pass.
Before a new helper or subsystem, check existing Pine, NARestraints, Cedar and campaign owners. Missing shared interfaces are a coordination task, not a reason to fork their machinery.
Do not advance sideways into deferred chemistry, providers or elaborate UI polish to avoid a failed physical gate. Keep failed/ambiguous/no-op outcomes legitimate.

Validate focused behavior and installation during development; complete integration/full regression, native/platform/relocation and human checks before a supported release or merge. Pushing experimental work does not authorize merging.
Keep scientific inputs/results local unless explicitly authorized for publication. Runtime artifacts use declared anchors and checksums; this roadmap grants no runtime permission.

E_MASKED_NATIVE.kind: Local masked native and contact-preservation controls
E_MASKED_NATIVE.result: Complete Phenix 2.2.1-6174 local masked trials validate every movable ASU derivative before/after optimization and PDB rounding. Complete NAR recipes and matched core-pair controls pass readback; broader bend plus fixed-base cleanup removes its added angle and three inherited ones with all base coordinates fixed. Native bond edits alter exclusions; collateral periodic overlap and individual geometry regressions remain.

Better intended contacts, lower total energy and fewer severe scalar outliers do not qualify surrounding packing. No production masked adapter, diffraction comparison or scientific acceptance. Local scientific files/workers excluded from Git.

E_PACKING.result: Thin comparison reuses Cedar capture/authentication and directed pair replay. E_PACKING.limitation: Read-only unchanged-policy scope. Directed counts are not unique physical contacts, a clashscore or chemical acceptance. No independent neighbor enumeration, torsion/plane comparison, native optimizer or model promotion.

E_PUBLIC_REFERENCE.result: Three complete Phenix 2.2.1-6174 coordinate-only runs preserve the same 3,333 observations and 176 free reflections. Final Rwork/Rfree: original .1776/.2284; cleanup .1779/.2274; bend+cleanup .1772/.2276. Selected contacts remain better with bending, but no meaningful additional held-out benefit is established. Native geometry/packing tradeoffs and exact readbacks are retained.
E_PUBLIC_REFERENCE.limitation: One already-refined public reference, no artificial MR damage or broader scientific acceptance. No added pair restraints, density inspection, weight tuning, campaign publication or adoption. S05 remains partial; generated artifacts stay local.

E_NATIVE_CALLBACK.result: Complete Phenix 2.2.1-6174 read-only energy/derivative/lifecycle probe: added two-atom image-term derivative error <5.4e-10, wrapper and energy-only calls pass; all-atom selection and symmetry discard drop the callback, normalized target count is unchanged, ordinary geometry flags do not disable it. E_NATIVE_CALLBACK.limitation: Artificial term, no full DNA recipe, optimizer/refinement or production callback integration. No generic normal-CLI callback loader demonstrated; captures remain local. Existing raw plane-gradient failures and bond-edit exclusion semantics still apply.
